name: George Soros
role: Investor and philanthropist; founder of the Open Society Foundations
summary: Soros advocates an open society built on political dissent, individual rights, and constitutional checks. He defends markets with public safeguards, favors European integration and international cooperation, and calls for rapid cuts in greenhouse-gas emissions.

human-caused-global-warming.rationale: He attributes disruption of the global climate to human activity, emphasizing the large-scale release of carbon dioxide and methane.

state-laws-apply-online.rationale: He calls for public authorities to regulate large online platforms as utilities in order to protect competition and access.

promote-democracy-abroad.rationale: He urges liberal democracies to promote freedom and democracy in and around the security alliances they build.

armed-resistance-to-occupation.rationale: He praises Ukraine’s armed resistance to the Russian invasion and urges other countries to mobilize their resources to help defeat it.

notes: Research covered economics, governing institutions, criminal justice, civil liberties, culture, migration, ecology, technology, international affairs, and methods of reform. Follow-up searches addressed religion and statehood, ethnic nationalism and minority rights, regional autonomy, and international security. Cannabis legalization and treatment for addiction are documented separately from general recreational-drug legalization. The author’s published excerpt from The Crisis of Global Capitalism and the mirror of its revised successor were reviewed.
